Sent:	Thursday, 11/07/2024 4:57 PM
To:	Burgess, James
Subject:	Updated Partnership Agreement

Har,

At long last, attached please find the updated agreement, in redline and final form. My instructions were to prepare execution copies, have them signed on behalf of the various Blackstone Equity entities, and they are being hand delivered to Mr. Joshua in your Deal Team for execution on behalf of the various Cedar Point entities. I also prepared guarantee agreements from Blackstone Holdings and from Cedar Point, each of which has been either executed or acknowledged on behalf of Blackstone. The decision upstairs was that this final version was "take it or leave it" for Cedar Point.

A summary of the major changes:

1.   All margining language and references to collateral were removed.
2.   All operating portfolio companies were included.
3.   The "Group" payment concept was eliminated in Section 4 because it was not clear who would actually be making the payment.

Thanks.

Oscar
